content: {"paper_id":"W2099501835","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"domain-adaptation","exact_quote":"cope with the considerable variation in feature distributions between videos from two domains (i.e., web video domain and consumer video domain)","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"明确以web视频域和consumer视频域之间的分布差异为适配对象，并提出A-MKL迁移方法，满足域适应设定。"},{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"leveraging a large amount of loosely labeled web videos (e.g., from YouTube)","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"使用大量松散标注的web视频作为不精确或粗粒度监督，并依赖该监督条件进行学习，符合弱监督设定。"},{"keyword_id":"multi-view-learning","exact_quote":"fuse the information from multiple pyramid levels and features (i.e., space-time features and static SIFT features)","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"同一视频对象具有时空特征与静态SIFT等互补特征表示，且方法显式融合多层级、多特征信息，满足多视图设定。"},{"keyword_id":"classifier-ensemble","exact_quote":"we first train a set of SVM classifiers based on the combined training set from two domains by using multiple base kernels from different kernel types and parameters, which are then fused with equal weights to obtain a prelearned average classifier","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"将多个SVM分类器的输出或权重等权融合为平均分类器，属于结合多个分类器预测完成分类的集成机制。"}],"abstentions":[{"keyword_id":"noisy-label-learning","reason_zh":"仅有“loosely labeled web videos”线索，未说明存在错误类别、真标签遗漏或不准确标签分布，无法确认噪声标签学习设定。"},{"keyword_id":"label-correlation-modeling","reason_zh":"使用所有事件类的预学习分类器可能涉及类间关系，但未明确说明建模标签共现、依赖或局部相关结构，证据不足。"}],"input_issues":[]}
